P7644.corridor_notes: 文23-安庆天然气管道项目 (Wen23 gas storage-Anqing gas pipeline project), built/owned by 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司西气东输分公司 (PipeChina West-East Gas Pipeline Branch). Per PipeChina's own Dec-2024 EIA public-participation notice: the whole project comprises 濮阳-亳州段 (Puyang-Bozhou, ~375.1km, = P7645), 亳州-淮南段 (Bozhou-Huainan, ~210.8km, = P7646), 淮南-安庆段 (Huainan-Anqing, ~265km, = P7647), plus two minor connectors not separately tracked as their own GEM rows: 濮阳联络站-鄂安沧管道连接线 (Puyang liaison station-E'anCang pipeline connector, 1.8km, co-trenched with the Wen23-storage-to-Puyang-liaison-station segment) and a 0.3km local reroute of the existing 西二线平泰支干线 at 菏泽分输清管站 (Heze, Shandong) so that line passes through a newly built 菏泽联络压气站. Total NEW pipe = 642.2km (=375.1+265+1.8+0.3; the 210.8km Bozhou-Huainan stretch is explicitly EXCLUDED from the new-build total because it reuses an existing/parallel corridor rather than laying new pipe there — see P7646 notes). The whole line starts at the existing Wen23 underground gas storage (converted from the depleted Wen23 gas field, in 中原油田/Zhongyuan Oilfield territory, Puyang, Henan) and ends at Anqing Liaison Station, Anhui, crossing Henan, Shandong (via the Heze reroute) and Anhui.
P7644.researcher_notes: P7644 is the parent/whole-line row; its route is the concatenation of P7645 (Puyang-Bozhou) + P7646 (Bozhou-Huainan) + P7647 (Huainan-Anqing), plus two minor sub-1.8km connectors PipeChina's notice lists but that do not appear to have their own GEM rows (a Puyang-liaison-station-to-鄂安沧-pipeline tie-in, and a 0.3km reroute of an unrelated existing line — 西二线平泰支干线 — near Heze, Shandong, to accommodate a new Heze liaison compressor station). Not a duplicate of the segment rows (different granularity — whole line vs. sub-segments), so duplicate_of is left null per instructions. GEM's LengthMergedKm (643.20) is close to but not identical to PipeChina's official total (642.2km, or 852.7km if you sum all three named segments without excluding the reused Bozhou-Huainan stretch) — a ~1km rounding/version difference, not flagged as material. Sheet's StartProvince/EndProvince (Henan/Anhui) match the source.

P7645.corridor_notes: 濮阳-亳州段 of the 文23-安庆天然气管道项目. Per PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA public-participation notice: '起于河南省濮阳市已建的文23储气库，止于安徽省亳州市的亳州南联络压气站，线路途经3省4市13区县，线路全长约375.1km，设计压力10MPa' (starts at the existing Wen23 gas storage in Puyang, Henan; ends at Bozhou South Liaison Compressor Station in Bozhou, Anhui; crosses 3 provinces/4 prefecture cities/13 counties-districts; ~375.1km; 10MPa design pressure). Sub-split: 文23储气库-濮阳联络站 is 1.8km at DN1016mm; 濮阳联络站-亳州南联络压气站 is 373.3km at DN1219mm. 6 stations and 13 valve chambers along this segment. The '3 provinces' crossed (vs. Henan-only start/end) implies the corridor briefly transits Shandong, matching the project's separate Heze (Shandong) reroute note in the same document (see P7644 corridor_notes).
P7645.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT SHEET FLAG: GEM's EndProvince for this row is 'Henan', but the source is explicit that the segment terminates in 安徽省亳州市 (Bozhou City, ANHUI province), not Henan — Bozhou is an Anhui prefecture-level city. Recommend a data-quality follow-up to correct EndProvince to Anhui (out of scope for this route-creation research; flagging only, not editing the sheet). This segment concatenates with P7646 (Bozhou-Huainan) and P7647 (Huainan-Anqing) to form the parent P7644.
P7645.blockers: Neither the start nor end facility resolves to a station-level OSM feature under its full official name except the storage complex itself (which does resolve, via a slightly different label '文23注采站'). Used Bozhou city-point as end fallback; a human GIS pass against the full EIA report (not located/opened — see search notes) could refine to the exact compressor-station site.

P7646.corridor_notes: 亳州-淮南段 of the 文23-安庆天然气管道项目, ~210.8km, DN1016mm. Per PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA notice, this segment does NOT get its own new pipe: '路由与川气东送二线天然气管道工程皖西支干线（预计2026年建成投产）高度重合，为避免重复建设，考虑此段路由依托皖西支干线。本项目对皖西支干线的阜阳分输清管站进行改扩建' (the route is highly coincident with the 皖西支干线/Anhui West branch of the separate 川气东送二线 project, expected online 2026; to avoid duplicate construction, this segment relies on/reuses the Anhui West branch's corridor; this project's own scope here is limited to renovating/expanding the Fuyang Distribution & Pigging Station — 阜阳分输清管站 — on that branch line). This is confirmed by two other PipeChina EIA notices for 川气东送二线天然气管道工程鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目: the Oct-2024 notice for the main trunk + several liaison lines (not this branch), and a May-2025 pre-approval notice specifically for '(皖西支干线、皖赣支干线)' (Anhui-West branch + Anhui-Jiangxi branch) confirming 皖西支干线 as a real, separately-EIA'd PipeChina project crossing Hubei/Henan/Anhui/Zhejiang/Fujian as part of the broader 川气东送二线 corridor. GEM's own P7613 ('Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line', 川气东送二线, 208.4km, Anhui-Anhui) is almost certainly this same 皖西支干线, run in the reverse direction (Huainan→Bozhou vs. this row's Bozhou→Huainan) — see duplicate/flag note below. Neither the exact route of 皖西支干线 nor the Fuyang station's precise coordinates were locatable in available sources; 阜阳市 (Fuyang, Anhui) sits roughly midway on the Bozhou-Huainan line and is the most likely intermediate waypoint.
P7646.researcher_notes: Matches the existing GEM ResearcherNotes on this row almost verbatim (both trace to the same PipeChina EIA notice), so treat this as strong corroboration of an already-correct note rather than a new finding. FLAG (not set as duplicate_of, per instructions): this segment's route is explicitly stated to physically reuse the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 corridor rather than laying new pipe — i.e., for GIS/route-drawing purposes, P7646's candidate geometry should likely BE (or very closely follow) P7613's geometry once that is drawn/sourced, just traversed in the opposite direction. Recommend the human reviewer check whether P7613 already has (or will get) a routes-repo geometry before independently drawing P7646, to avoid two near-identical but not-quite-matching traces for what is functionally one physical corridor. Endpoints given here are the same city-level approximations as P7645 (Bozhou) and P7647 (Huainan) start, for consistency across the three child segments.
P7646.blockers: No source gives station-level coordinates for either Bozhou South or Huainan liaison compressor stations, or for the Fuyang distribution/pigging station being renovated; all use city-level fallbacks. A human GIS pass against the underlying EIA report PDF (not opened — see P7644/P7645 notes) or the 川气东送二线 皖西支干线 EIA report would likely yield exact station coordinates and could also supply ready-made route geometry given the explicit corridor-reuse relationship to P7613.

P7647.corridor_notes: 淮南-安庆段 of the 文23-安庆天然气管道项目, per PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA notice: '起于安徽省淮南市的淮南联络压气站，止于安徽省安庆市的安庆联络站，线路途经1省4市7区县，全长约265km，设计压力10MPa，管径1016mm' (starts at Huainan Liaison Compressor Station, Huainan; ends at Anqing Liaison Station, Anqing; crosses 1 province/4 prefecture cities/7 counties-districts; ~265km; 10MPa; DN1016mm; 3 stations + 11 valve chambers). An independent, more granular county-level source (Shucheng County government notice, Lu'an/六安, Anhui) corroborates and adds detail: within Shucheng County alone the line runs 48.8km through six townships — 柏林乡, 棠树乡, 干汊河镇, 春秋乡, 南港镇, 舒茶镇 (Bailin, Tangshu, Ganchahe, Chunqiu, Nangang, Shucha) — with 2 valve chambers there, pipe diameter D1219mm (note: differs from PipeChina's 1016mm figure for the segment overall — likely a later/updated design-stage change, not two different pipelines; both sources independently confirm the same start '文23储气库注采站/文23注采站' and end '安庆联络站' naming), and a design annual capacity of 30 bcm/y. Shucheng County sits on the Huainan-Anqing corridor via Lu'an (六安) prefecture, one of the '4 市' crossed.
P7647.researcher_notes: Best-sourced of the three child segments — two independent sources (PipeChina's own EIA notice and a Shucheng County, Lu'an government notice) agree on both endpoint names and corroborate the route passing through Lu'an prefecture (Shucheng County specifically, with township-level detail), satisfying the 2+ independent source bar for the route claim itself (endpoint names, not full coordinates). Concatenates with P7645+P7646 (via P7646's end = this row's start = 淮南联络压气站) to form parent P7644.
P7647.blockers: Neither 淮南联络压气站 nor 安庆联络站 resolves to a station-level OSM feature; both endpoints use city-level fallback coordinates. Shucheng County's 6-township list gives strong corridor-level detail for the segment's western portion (Lu'an prefecture) but was not itself geocoded to a waypoint since the output schema calls only for start/end. A human GIS pass could use the six named townships (all in Shucheng County, 六安市) as intermediate waypoints when actually drawing this segment.

P7613.corridor_notes: GEM lists this row as '川气东送二线输气管道 / 川气东送二线天然气管道工程' Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line, Network=川气东送二线, ResearcherNotes(MZ)='鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目东段二阶段' (Hubei-Henan-Jiangxi-Anhui-Zhejiang-Fujian section project, east section phase 2) — i.e. part of PipeChina's 川气东送二线天然气管道工程鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目. PipeChina's own May-2025 EIA pre-approval notice (3002862.html) is specifically titled '...鄂豫赣皖浙闽段项目(皖西支干线、皖赣支干线)环境影响评价报批前公示' — confirming 皖西支干线 (Anhui West Branch Line) is a real, separately-EIA'd component of this exact project, crossing Hubei/Henan/Anhui/Zhejiang/Fujian. Separately, PipeChina's Dec-2024 EIA notice for the unrelated 文23-安庆天然气管道项目 (3002110.html) states its own Bozhou-Huainan segment (P7646, ~210.8km) '路由与川气东送二线天然气管道工程皖西支干线...高度重合...依托皖西支干线' (route highly coincides with / relies on the 皖西支干线). Chaining these two facts: this row (P7613, 'Huainan-Bozhou Branch Line', 208.40km, 川气东送二线) is almost certainly the same 皖西支干线 named in both notices, run start-to-end in the reverse direction from P7646 (P7613: Huainan→Bozhou per GEM's own existing StartLocation/EndLocation; P7646: Bozhou→Huainan). The near-identical lengths (208.40km vs 210.80km) further support this — the small delta is consistent with P7646 counting a bit of extra distance for its own tie-in/renovation work at the Fuyang distribution/pigging station (阜阳分输清管站, on this branch) rather than a genuinely different alignment.
P7613.researcher_notes: STRONG FLAG (per task instructions, not set as duplicate_of): this row and P7646 (文23-安庆天然气管道 Bozhou-Huainan segment) are very likely the same physical corridor traversed in opposite directions — P7646's own project explicitly states it 'relies on'/reuses this 皖西支干线 route rather than building new pipe, and GEM's own StartLocation/EndLocation for the two rows are already mirror images of each other (Huainan→Bozhou here vs. Bozhou→Huainan there). Recommend treating whichever of P7613/P7646 gets routed FIRST (via a routes-repo PR or vector trace) as the geometry source for the other, rather than independently drawing two near-duplicate corridors. Endpoint coordinates and station-level names here are INFERRED from the P7646/parent-project source describing the corridor overlap, not from a source that names P7613's/皖西支干线's own endpoint stations directly by name — no source located gives 皖西支干线's own start/end station names or exact route explicitly (the May-2025 EIA pre-approval notice only announces the report's existence, without repeating route/station details in the announcement text itself).
P7613.blockers: No source located names 皖西支干线's own endpoint stations directly (only the project title and provincial extent from the May-2025 PipeChina notice, plus the corridor-overlap statement from the separate 文23-安庆 project's notice). Endpoints/coordinates here are inferred via that overlap and via GEM's own existing Start/EndLocation fields, not independently confirmed by name. The full EIA report for 川气东送二线...(皖西支干线、皖赣支干线) is linked from the PipeChina notice at http://rise.cnpc.com.cn/bjzyjs/wsgs/202505/ec1f1213832943898db14df7fee10d9c.shtml but was not retrievable/opened in this pass (internal CNPC document portal, not fetched) — a human follow-up opening that report would very likely give exact station names/coordinates and should be treated as authoritative over this inference if it differs.
